opportunities.name_zh: Lady Bird Johnson Grove・巨木紅木森林與步道縱深
opportunities.best_time: 白天可見光；陰天／柔光亦可成立
opportunities.best_season: 全年；冬季風雨與道路／步道狀態仍需查看官方公告

condition_variants.variant_name: Lady Bird Johnson Grove巨木紅木林／步道縱深
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Lady Bird Johnson Grove Camera Zone","subject":"old-growth coast redwoods + forest-trail depth"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 正式步道可使用；不得離開步道踩踏保護植被
condition_variants.required_conditions: 紅木巨木與森林步道層次可辨；無足以妨礙步行攝影的強降水
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和散射光；林下濕潤；低人流
condition_variants.penalties: 強風雨；倒木／步道封閉；妨礙其他遊客

viewpoints.note: NPS identifies Lady Bird Johnson Grove as a popular old-growth redwood walk and multiple trail stops as Scenic View/Photo Spots. Existing NPS-based coordinate remains the Camera Zone anchor.
viewpoints.name: Lady Bird Johnson Grove Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 1.5-mile Lady Bird Johnson Grove正式環狀步道；只在合法步道內移動構圖。

opportunities.name_zh: Lady Bird Johnson Grove・霧中紅木森林
opportunities.best_time: 實際有林間霧／低雲進入紅木林時；夏季沿岸霧常見但不得由月份保證
opportunities.best_season: 全年可發生；NPS指出夏季霧常見

condition_variants.variant_name: Lady Bird Johnson Grove霧林紅木
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Lady Bird Johnson Grove Camera Zone","subject":"old-growth redwoods visibly layered within ground cloud / forest fog"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 林間霧實際存在；正式步道可使用
condition_variants.required_conditions: 霧氣在紅木林內形成可辨層次且主要樹幹仍可讀；不是單純鏡頭外遠方低雲
condition_variants.boosters: 柔光；低風；霧層厚度適中；林下水氣形成空氣透視
condition_variants.penalties: 霧濃到主要樹體完全不可辨；強風雨；步道封閉

viewpoints.note: NPS explicitly documents fog blanketing the redwood forest at Lady Bird Johnson Grove and classifies the trail stop as a Scenic View/Photo Spot. Runtime mist-state support is not yet implemented.
viewpoints.name: Lady Bird Johnson Grove Fog Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 同一正式紅木林步道範圍；霧題材必須由實際林間水氣狀態證實。
